facts.fact: Nairametrics, analysing NCC state-by-state data, says Nigeria has 101,148.36 km of fibre-optic cable deployed, with Lagos and the FCT holding 18,559.83 km (18.35%); no date given, so the article's published date is used.
Nairametrics, from NCC data, says the 101,148.36 km of fibre is deployed across all 36 states and the FCT, though concentrated in Lagos and Abuja; article date used as no other is given.

note: Bridge OA incorporation and planned open-access wholesale network are plans, not building or open access in service.
